answer_1.quote: Automatic ... aims to reduce manual post-editing effort by automatically fixing errors in the machine-translated output. ... We compile a new large post-edited corpus, SubEdits, which consists of actual human post-edits ... to train a state-of-the-art neural APE model.
answer_1.outputs: post-edited translations (target language text after automatic post-editing)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the models using three different automatic metrics: BLEU, ChrF, and TER.

answer_4.quote: We hired five German native freelance translators ... were asked to rate the adequacy (from 1 to 5) for three German translations: (1) the do-nothing baseline output (NMT), (2) BERT Enc-Dec APE output (APE), and (3) the human post-edited text (Human).
answer_4.guideline: Rate adequacy on a 1-5 scale for each translation (NMT baseline, APE output, human post-edit).
